statuses.draft: Exists in the prototype, not written down as a shared pattern.
statuses.in-review: Documented as the shared pattern, not yet measured in the browser.
statuses.stable: Documented and verified in the browser for Accura.

items.name: App shell
items.description: Shared sidebar plus the application header bar that holds the module title, notifications and account. Every module page sits inside it; a page never builds its own sidebar.

items.name: Dashboard
items.description: Home screen: summary cards and the work inbox. The landing page of the product.

items.name: Record detail
items.description: Detail screen: phase gate stepper across the top, main column of record sections, side rail with the current gate and next action, audit trail in a drawer.
items.note: Only Documents and Knowledge Hub render RecordDetailLayout (checked 2026-09-28). The Change Control and CAPA detail screens build their own layout.

items.name: Create and edit form
items.description: Create or edit screen: centred max-width column, page heading, form sections, one primary action.

items.name: Record list
items.description: Listing screen: header title, full-width toolbar with search, filters and Create, the list summary row, the table with row actions, pagination, and the filtered empty state in place of the table.

items.name: Settings
items.description: Settings area: section navigation with lookup tables, user screens and form screens inside the settings shell.

items.name: Audit trail drawer
items.description: Sheet listing a record's audit entries, latest first: actor, role and time, action, state change pill, signature when taken.

items.name: Electronic signature modal
items.description: Signs a regulated record: signer identity, meaning, optional reason, attestation. One implementation shared by every module.

items.name: List empty state
items.description: Replaces the table when a list is empty. ListEmptySearch when filters matched nothing, ListEmptySet when there is nothing to filter.

items.name: List summary
items.description: Row between toolbar and table: the record count, or how many of how many while filtered, with Clear filters.

items.name: Loading
items.description: One loader per case: app splash, route bar with skeletons, a skeleton and error per widget, a page refresh that dims and locks, a button's loading state, a long-task toast. Shown after 300ms, kept at least 500ms.
items.note: Not wired into any module yet; the Dashboard demo is the only consumer. The catalog's Loading tab runs the demo with its controls.

items.name: Phase gate stepper
items.description: Record progress across its stages, the current gate, and who the record is waiting for.
items.note: Documented as the master but imported by no module (checked 2026-09-28). Detail screens render Stepper directly.

items.name: Record section
items.description: Titled card block on a detail screen, optionally collapsible for locked, read-once content.

items.name: Row click
items.description: Hook that makes a whole table row open its record while menus and links inside the row keep their own clicks. Behaviour only, nothing to render.

items.name: State change pill
items.description: Old value struck through, arrow, new value, in one tinted pill. Direction sets the tone: forward, backward or cancel.

items.name: Table pagination
items.description: Listing footer with page size and page controls, plus the usePagination hook that keeps the page in range as filters shrink the set.

items.name: RecordRowAction
items.description: The last column of a record listing: one ghost icon button that opens the row's record. Pins itself to the right edge of the scrollport when the table overflows horizontally, on an overlay surface with a shadow, revealed by row hover or focus on fine pointers and always visible on coarse ones. Exports RecordRowAction (the cell) and RecordRowActionHeading (its header cell). Renders exactly one action — there is no overflow menu in this system.

items.name: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate activity indicator for small areas: inside a button, an input, a status pill. Code-only. The Loading02 icon spinning in currentColor; the same icon Toast uses, so there is one spinner in the system.

items.name: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: Alert
items.description: Inline feedback banners for system-level messages. Three variants: Default (neutral), Destructive (error), Warning (caution). Non-blocking — does not steal focus or require a decision.

items.name: AlertDialog
items.description: A modal overlay that requires an explicit user decision before the page can continue. Use when both confirm and cancel are real choices, not when cancel is simply 'close the modal'.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: A circular user representation with image, initials fallback, 3 sizes, and optional online/offline status indicator.

items.name: Badge
items.description: A small status label used to categorise, tag, or communicate state. Supports 11 visual variants, 3 shapes, and 3 sizes.

items.name: Breadcrumb
items.description: Navigation trail showing the user's location within a hierarchy.

items.name: Button
items.description: A clickable action element. Supports 6 visual types, 5 states, and 6 sizes including icon-only variants.

items.name: ButtonGroup
items.description: A bordered container that visually groups related ghost buttons into a connected control.

items.name: Calendar
items.description: A date and range selection control built from composable calendar-day, calendar-month, preset, and calendar component sets.

items.name: Card
items.description: A structured container for self-contained, independently meaningful blocks of information. Built on shadcn Card — purely presentational, no Radix primitive. A shell that owns surface, border, radius, and padding; content is freely composed inside.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: A binary selection control used to toggle an option on or off, with optional description text.

items.name: Combobox
items.description: A searchable, filterable dropdown control — single selection, multi-selection, search-as-you-type, free-form tag entry, or time selection.

items.name: DatePicker
items.description: An input trigger that opens a calendar popup for selecting a single date, date range, or typed date input.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: A modal overlay that interrupts the user to present focused content or collect input. Built on Radix UI Dialog. Renders a full-screen backdrop with a centered popup; focus is trapped inside until dismissed.

items.name: Drawer
items.description: A sliding panel that emerges from an edge of the screen or centers responsively as an overlay.

items.name: Empty
items.description: A placeholder displayed when a list, panel, or section has no content. Icon + title + description + optional action buttons. Three Variants control container surface. Purely presentational — no Radix primitive.

items.name: Input
items.description: A single-line text input control. Built on the native HTML input element. Use for name, email, password, search, and any single-line text entry.

items.name: InputOTP
items.description: A one-time password input built from individual slot cells grouped into a single control.

items.name: Item
items.description: A compact, repeatable list-row component for a single entry in a list, feed, or menu. Six leading Types, three container Variants, and three Sizes. Always use 'item' — never '_item-image' standalone.

items.name: Label
items.description: Field label with an optional required marker. Consumed by input-field, select-field and combobox-field; the parent field owns the state.

items.name: NavigationMenu
items.description: A horizontal site navigation bar with dropdown panels. Built on Radix UI NavigationMenu. Three component sets: nav-button (trigger or link), nav-panel (dropdown panel), and nav-panel-link (link row inside panel).

items.name: Pagination
items.description: A navigation control for moving through multi-page data sets.

items.name: Progress
items.description: A horizontal progress bar for communicating operation completion percentage or indeterminate loading state. Built on Radix UI Progress. Tracks with a fill indicator driven by value 0–100 or null for indeterminate.

items.name: RadioGroup
items.description: A single-select control used within a radio group, with Basic row and Choice card layouts.

items.name: Select
items.description: A dropdown control for choosing one option from a predefined fixed list.

items.name: Separator
items.description: A visual divider between sections of content. One token, two orientations, no states, no children.

items.name: Sheet
items.description: A slide-in panel from the viewport edge for secondary tasks — filters, navigation, detail panels, settings. Built on Radix UI Dialog with a side prop. Shares the same primitive as Dialog but is positional rather than centered.

items.name: Sidebar
items.description: A composable, themeable application sidebar for primary navigation with collapsible state, mobile overlay, and keyboard shortcut.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder that pulses while content is fetching. Code-only — no published Figma component. Compose multiple instances to mirror the real content layout.

items.name: Slider
items.description: A range input control that lets users select a value by dragging a thumb along a track.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: Horizontal or vertical progress indicator for a multi-step process. Shows which steps are complete, which is current, and which remain. Also known as Progress Steps.

items.name: Switch
items.description: A toggle control for binary on/off choices, with a visual switch and a labeled switch-item row.

items.name: Table
items.description: A semantic data table. Purely presentational — renders HTML table elements. Three component sets: table-head (header cells), table-cell (47 content types), and _table-row (rows with state). No built-in sorting or filtering — use TanStack Table for that.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: A navigation component for switching between content sections.

items.name: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input for free-form prose. Built on the native HTML textarea element. Use for notes, comments, descriptions, and any content where the user needs more than one line.

items.name: Toast
items.description: A temporary floating notification for system feedback — confirmations, errors, warnings, and async status. Built on Sonner (imperative API); dismissed automatically after a timeout or by the user.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: A floating label that appears on hover or focus to provide supplementary context.
